com.secugen.secusearch.api

Class SSErrorCode

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.secugen.secusearch.api.SSErrorCode

  • public class SSErrorCode
extends Object
    A class containing all the SecuSearch error codes. SecuSearch throws a SSException with one of the error codes.
    See Also:
    SSException.getErrorCode()
